evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that specifies a fast, reliable return frames the design as mastery of craft and preservation of system integrity.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Appealing to durability against failure as the good — the system holds what works and loses nothing.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Designing the agent's own choice of retrieval cadence appeals to self-origination and capability of the consumer.
